title: Beyond Graph Serialization: Topology-Aware Low-Rank Operators for Small Language Models
content: Labeled property graphs combine relational structure with heterogeneous textual and numerical properties. Small language models can process such graphs through textual serialization, but this representation requires the model to recover adjacency indirectly from a token sequence. We introduce a lightweight architecture that preserves the serialized language-model interface while adding explicit graph computation inside selected decoder layers. Graph-sparse, low-rank residual operators pool node-span representations, route messages along directed edges, and return the resulting updates to the corresponding token spans. The pretrained backbone, serialized input, and vocabulary-based prediction head remain unchanged, avoiding a separate graph encoder. We evaluate the approach on controlled topology-sensitive classification tasks over real financial and legislative labeled property graphs. The results demonstrate that explicit topology can improve graph-serialized language models.
